attrs.evidence: R5 already declared its receipt non-decisive and said why. GPT-5.6 sharpened what decisive would mean, and the sharpening matters: today the gate checks that `decision.verdict` is a member of {promote, reject, quarantine, rollback}, which validates the SHAPE of a candidate-supplied answer. In the decisive form the verdict does not appear in the input at all — the function verifies digests and refs, evaluates the hard constraints, applies the selection policy, records which checks ran, and emits verdict and receipt atomically. Then there is no second representation to drift. NOT BUILT, and deliberately not faked: mosaic/receipts/INV-R5.1.json carries honesty.decisive = false.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6, round-5 Mosaic audit §9. in-toto's layout + signed link metadata is the mature shape for the provenance half.
attrs.statement: A decisive receipt is the OUTPUT of one admission function — adjudicate(candidate, inputs) -> (verdict, receipt) — not a document written after a gate ran and checked for a well-formed verdict field.
